name: Raclette
origin: Switzerland - Canton of Valais; also Savoie, France

salt_pct.quote: NaCl concentrations ... 27.0 ±0.1, 21.5 ±0.2, and 26.3 ±0.1 g kg-1, respectively, for cheeses A, B, and C

compounds.quote: with butanoic acid concentrations of 27, 77, and 155 mg kg-1, respectively, and hexanoic acid concentrations of 10, 40, and 62 mg kg-1, respectively, in cheeses C, A, and B
compounds.name: butanoic acid

compounds.quote: with butanoic acid concentrations of 27, 77, and 155 mg kg-1, respectively, and hexanoic acid concentrations of 10, 40, and 62 mg kg-1, respectively, in cheeses C, A, and B
compounds.name: hexanoic acid

ammonia.reason: Surface deacidification by Brevibacterium/Staphylococcus deamination raises pH 5.31 to 5.65 with moderate NH3.

animal_barnyard.reason: Washed-rind Brevibacterium linens catabolism producing p-cresol, indole and isovaleric traces.

bitter.reason: Moderate rennet and plasmin proteolysis to hydrophobic peptides at 3 months, balanced by salt.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation; methyl ketone 2-heptanone only 9-18 ug/kg.

browning.reason: Maillard between residual galactose and proteolysis-derived lysine during raclette grilling.

buttery.reason: Milk fat 28.5% plus mesophilic starter citrate to diacetyl/acetoin, though GC levels low.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Lipolysis to butanoic 27-155 mg/kg and hexanoic 10-62 mg/kg plus total FFA 0.9-2.9 g/kg.

creaminess.reason: High fat-in-dry-matter ~49% and moisture 41.8% give smooth fat-coated mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Pressed elastic paste at pH 5.65 with colloidal calcium retained, not acid-crumbly.

firmness.reason: Semi-hard pressed and cooked curd at 41.8% moisture, 3-month proteolysis softens paste.

floral_honey.reason: Very low phenylalanine catabolites; phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol not detected.

fruity.reason: Esterification to ethyl butanoate 9-16.5 ug/kg by lactic acid bacteria esterases.

goaty.reason: Cow milk fat lacks caprine branched C8-C10 acids; 4-methyloctanoic not found.

malty_nutty.reason: Leucine/isoleucine Strecker to 3-methylbutanal 1-3.5 ug/kg and 2-methylbutanal plus propionate.

melt.reason: pH 5.6 intact para-casein with 41.8% moisture flows fully on heating, signature raclette melt.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Smear Geotrichum/Brevibacterium lipoxygenase traces; 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one not quantified.

oil_off.reason: 28.5% fat coalesces to free oil when heated above casein contraction temperature.

smoky.reason: Not smoked; no guaiacol/phenol exposure, curd cooked only to ~42-45C.

sour_vinegar.reason: Acetic acid 751-961 mg/kg (12.5-16 mmol/kg) from lactate/acetate metabolism, pH 5.65.

stretch.reason: Rennet gel, not pasta-filata acid-stretch; flows without aligned fibrous casein.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Methionine catabolism by Brevibacterium to dimethyl disulfide 17-101 ug/kg and trisulfide.

sweet.reason: Lactose depleted but galactose/propionate and glycine/alanine give mild sweet.

umami.reason: 3-month proteolysis releasing glutamate and savory peptides, enhanced by 2.7% NaCl.
